messages.subject: Plot analysis without removing soil
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to analyse my plots without removing the soil. My supervisor believes that not removing the soil can be benificial to compare the altum data with other device data.

I have tried to simply put the croped image into idex calculation line but i get the error:
Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)) :error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'stack': invalid layer names
Here is how the code looks like:
EX1.Crop <- fieldCrop(mosaic = EX1, fast.plot = T)
DataTable<-read.csv("DataTable.csv",header = T)
fieldMap<-fieldMap(fieldPlot=DataTable$Plot, fieldColumn=DataTable$Row, fieldRow=DataTable$Range, decreasing=T)
EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.Crop, ncols = 21, nrows = 9, fieldMap = fieldMap)
EX1.Indices<- fieldIndex(mosaic = EX1.Crop$newMosaic, Red = 3, Green = 2, Blue = 1, RedEdge=6, NIR=5, index = c("NDVI"))

Seems like a simple task, but im not sure what is going wrong

Best,
Artūrs
